articles.title: Ray Dalio says investors should own ‘a bit of Bitcoin’ as U.S. debt risks rise
articles.snippet: The Bridgewater founder says recent Treasury-market stress fits his long-running debt-crisis framework, though he still prefers gold as the bigger hedge.

articles.title: We are so back! Bitcoin’s 23% rally on US debt policy: Hodler’s Digest
articles.snippet: The US may face a debt crisis within three years according to Ray Dalio, and debt-related issues helped fuel a rally in Bitcoin that could mark the beginning of a new cycle.

articles.title: Ray Dalio says to buy ‘a bit’ of Bitcoin amid potential debt crisis
articles.snippet: The hedge fund founder with an estimated net worth of $15 billion recommended that investors overweight Bitcoin and gold rather than bonds.
